verdict.rationale: Obsidian Publish is a first-party feature explicitly for turning selected notes into a hosted, browsable digital garden with working links ("Select the notes you want to share... press Publish, and we'll host it at publish.obsidian.md/your-site"), and linking notes creates a network of working links carried through to publish. This is done from within the app without leaving it. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community evidence confirming the publish workflow or link fidelity in practice, and no detail on customization/theming limits.
